exclusion_note: Derived by cross-referencing the top 2,000 European surfaces against the Portuguese Wiktionary extract: a surface with no Portuguese entry, or filed only as a name, is not vocabulary. Hyphenated clitics (da-me, ve-lo) are deliberately NOT excluded despite lacking entries -- they are exactly the European constructions this deck exists to teach. See the note in docs/reference/portuguese-v7-baseline.md. Extended for the 3000-surface scope: ranks 2001-3000 introduced 88 menu-less non-clitic surfaces, almost all English names and place names from untranslated credit lines, plus the subtitle-credit words 'legendagem' and 'pt-subs' (which retained a single usable sentence). 'convidados' and 'poucas' were deliberately NOT excluded: they are ordinary Portuguese whose menu is missing only because Wiktionary indexes the singular, and excluding them would delete real vocabulary. Hyphenated clitics stay in.
